A. LIQUIDITY_REVERSAL_MASTER (Mean-Reversion / Sweep Hunter)
   ✓ TRIGGER: Price pierces/sweeps S1, R1, or Swing High/Low and shows wick rejection (re-enters the previous range).
   ✓ MOMENTUM: Volume spike > 1.1x–1.2x baseline OR immediate CVD divergence (order flow exhaustion).
   ✓ BIAS: Valid for BOTH Long (Sweep of S1/Lows) and Short (Sweep of R1/Highs).

B. PULLBACK_CONTINUATION (Momentum Dip/Rally Rider)
   ✓ TRIGGER: Price retests EMA dynamic support/resistance (EMA {ema_fast}/{ema_slow}) during a trending sequence.
   ✓ MOMENTUM: ADX > 10 (any visible directional drift) OR price holding above/below EMA zone.
   ✓ BIAS: Long on shallow pullbacks in rising structure; Short on rejections in descending structure.

C. BREAKDOWN_FOLLOW (Breakout / Flow Expansion)
   ✓ TRIGGER: Price tests or breaches S1/R1 with candle body closing near extreme (low wick on close) indicating continuation.
   ✓ MOMENTUM: Expanding candle range or volume exceeding the previous 3-bar average.
   ✓ BIAS: Short on structural breakdown below S1/support; Long on breakout above R1/resistance.

D. WAIT (Absolute Last Resort)
   ✓ USE ONLY IF: Complete volume dry-up, spread compression, and price consolidating tightly dead-center with ZERO wick activity or directional momentum.

1. VISUAL PATTERNS: Identify Chart Patterns (e.g. Head & Shoulders, Flags, Wedges, Double Top/Bottom).
2. MACD DIVERGENCE (Bottom Panel): Look for divergences between Price and MACD Histogram/Lines.
